msg: There are 8 different color gnomes, split into 2 groups. The pink,red,purple, and brown gnomes take you to the red basket. The blue,yellow,orange, and green gnomes take you to the yellow basket. The ammount of mushrooms you recieve goes through alternating phases. For example if you go with the group of gnomes that select the red basket and recieve 4+ mushrooms, continue going with the group that selects the red basket. If they start to give you 3 or less mushrooms you should switch to the group that selects the yellow basket. You will know youve switched groups too early if you recieve 1 or 0 after switching.
